title: Observe a real tenant migration and mixed-generation rollout on the live vuoro-cloud cluster

blockers.description: No live rollout carries a tenant work-schema migration yet. The first one is the vuoro-service 0.1.94 to 0.1.104 roll (work schema 31), which is itself blocked on its pin PR and the tenant schema-version mapping.
blockers.resolved_by: package vuoro-service-0-1-104-rollout reaching its step 2 (promotion of the head that carries the pin change)

blockers.description: P5 verification runs in the controller only from the generation that contains it; the live controller image predates #353 until the next promotion.
blockers.resolved_by: package vuoro-cloud-poc-promotion for a main head that contains vuoro-cloud#353

why_operator: The observation rides a signed promotion and a tenant runtime roll on the live cluster; both are deployment effects behind the operator's YubiKey promotion key and age key, and the read uses the operator token, which is not delegated to agents.

preconditions.check: vuoro-cloud#353 (P5 tenant catalog verification, convergence_reason, scripted rollback plan) is merged on canonical main
preconditions.command: git fetch origin && git merge-base --is-ancestor bcc55a9b1321d415e470be558deeb67dabc5b6ed origin/main && echo merged

preconditions.check: The deployed controller generation contains #353 (rollout/status reports convergence_reason)
preconditions.expected: true (false or a missing field means the promotion with #353 has not happened)

preconditions.check: The operator checkout is at or past bcc55a9, so python -m vuoro_cloud.tenant_rollback exists for the rollback path
preconditions.command: cd /projects/dev/vuoro-cloud && git status -sb && git merge-base --is-ancestor bcc55a9b1321d415e470be558deeb67dabc5b6ed HEAD && test -f src/vuoro_cloud/tenant_rollback.py && echo current
preconditions.observed: 2026-11-07: the shared checkout was behind origin/main and lacked tenant_rollback.py; run git pull --ff-only first

commands.expected: baseline: maintenance_workspaces lists only the known held tenants; runtime pin 0.1.94 (or unknown with a reason)

commands.command: Run package vuoro-service-0-1-104-rollout; while its promotion reconciles, repeat every 30 s until the pilot workspace is READY: curl -fsS -A agentops-operator -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat ~/.config/vuoro/credentials/vuoro-cloud.token)" https://api.vuoro.cloud/api/control/v1/operator/rollout/status | jq -c '{convergence_reason, maintenance_workspaces}' | tee -a ~/vuoro-live-migration-proof.jsonl
commands.expected: convergence_reason moves from other-generation-serving to current-generation-only; the pilot workspace passes through MIGRATING and leaves maintenance_workspaces as READY, never ROLLBACK_REQUIRED
state READY at the roll's generation; the tenant catalog verification passed before READY (no failure_detail)

expected_result: First live evidence that a tenant work-schema migration passes P5 catalog verification before READY and that convergence is reported during a real mixed-generation window. Closes the 'live mixed-generation proof' residual in vuoro-cloud 18-MULTITENANT-VERSIONING-AND-MIGRATION.md for the POC cluster; the Talos proof stays in package vuoro-cloud-staging-rehearsal.
send_back: If the workspace reached ROLLBACK_REQUIRED: the output of python -m vuoro_cloud.tenant_rollback plan --workspace <id> --checkpoint-ref <ref> and nothing else changed

rollback.description: Observation is read-only. If the tenant migration fails, the workspace stays fenced in ROLLBACK_REQUIRED; run the read-only rollback plan, restore from the recorded checkpoint per 18-MULTITENANT-VERSIONING-AND-MIGRATION.md, then verify-restored. The runtime pin rolls back through package vuoro-service-0-1-104-rollout's rollback.
commands: Run the rollback of package vuoro-service-0-1-104-rollout
